newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL blue-chip index up sharply on local fund buying.
newsitem.headline: KL blue-chip index up sharply on local fund buying.

text.p: Blue-chip prices reversed several days of declines on buying by local funds and the overnight rise on Wall Street, brokers said on Tuesday.
At 0330 GMT, the benchmark Composite Index was up 18.08 points to 1,059.47. The second-board index was up 14.03 points to 549.91.
"It's the locals that are in there at the moment. I am sitting on three pages of sell orders (from foreign clients)," said a dealer at a local bank-backed brokerage.

He said foreign clients were awaiting the release of Singapore's trade data and the outcome of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting later on Tuesday which some fear would result in a 25-basis point hike in interest rates.
